$comment: Baseline for the scheduled Figma↔code component parity check (scripts/figma-drift.mjs). Updated by every /figma-pull and /figma-push. Each component records the token bindings (var) AND the resolved Dawn-mode raw values (raw) as of the last sync; the checker flags drift when BOTH stop matching. code.classes is the container class string the code twin must still carry. `candidates` lists Figma twins not yet under the check (Wave A, from figma/components/README.md); `figma-drift.mjs --adopt` (the figma-parity workflow's `adopt` input) moves each into `components` once Figma and code agree, and reports the ones that do not. `patterns` is the block-to-Figma map: one entry per registry/blocks file — mirrored (❖ page + pattern frame ids, presence checked daily), missing (not built yet) or declined (reason recorded); scripts/figma-pattern-coverage.test.mjs keeps it complete. Mirrored entries carry codeHash + syncedAt (the block source hash at the last Figma sync; scripts/figma-restamp.test.mjs fails when the block moves without its page) or stale: <reason>. `foundations` carries the token-source hash at the last foundations sync. `declined` lists the primitives that get no twin, with the reason; scripts/figma-component-coverage.test.mjs keeps components + candidates + declined equal to src/components/ui.
